<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_1776078_cyber_0_cyber_incident</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="x_1776078_cyber_0_cyber_incident">data_classification_of_affected_assetsVALCHANGES^EQ<item endquery="false" field="data_classification_of_affected_assets" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Update REG when no longer private info</name><order>130</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/ ) {

    //check if data classificaiton previously held 'private information'
    var previousPrivateInfo = previous.getValue('data_classification_of_affected_assets') || '';
    var currentPrivateInfo = current.getValue('data_classification_of_affected_assets') || '';
    if (previousPrivateInfo.indexOf('private_information') != -1  && currentPrivateInfo.indexOf('private_information') == -1 ) {

        //check for active NDB notification task
        var existingReg = new GlideRecord('x_1776078_cyber_0_regulatory_notification_task');
        existingReg.addQuery('parent_cyber_incident', current.sys_id);
        existingReg.addQuery('notification_type', 'oaic_ndb_notification');
        var existingRegOr = existingReg.addQuery('state', '-5');
        existingRegOr.addOrCondition('state', '1');
        existingRegOr.addOrCondition('state', '2');
        existingRegOr.addOrCondition('state', '3');
        existingReg.query();

        //if NDB notification exists add a work note advising the CYB no longer contains private information
        if (existingReg.next()) {
            existingReg.work_notes = 'Data Classification has been updated and no longer contains Private Information — please review whether this OAIC/NDB notification task is still required';
            existingReg.update();
        }
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-08 04:17:27</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>c5adac4a83a2c71044779cb6feaad37b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>17</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Update REG when no longer private info</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Cyber Incident Management" source="x_1776078_cyber_0">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Cyber Incident Management">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_c5adac4a83a2c71044779cb6feaad37b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-08 05:02:44</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=c5adac4a83a2c71044779cb6feaad37b"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_1776078_cyber_0_cyber_incident</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="x_1776078_cyber_0_cyber_incident">data_classification_of_affected_assetsLIKEprivate_information^EQ<item endquery="false" field="data_classification_of_affected_assets" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="LIKE" or="false" value="private_information"/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Create REG when private information</name><order>150</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/ ) {

    //check for existing OAIC / NDB notifications
    var existingReg = new GlideRecord('x_1776078_cyber_0_regulatory_notification_task');
    existingReg.addQuery('parent_cyber_incident', current.sys_id);
    existingReg.addQuery('notification_type', 'oaic_ndb_notification');
    var existingRegOr = existingReg.addQuery('state', '-5');
    existingRegOr.addOrCondition('state', '1');
    existingRegOr.addOrCondition('state', '2');
    existingRegOr.addOrCondition('state', '3');
    existingReg.setLimit(1);
    existingReg.query();

    //if REG does not exist, create one
    if (!existingReg.next()) {
        var newReg = new GlideRecord('x_1776078_cyber_0_regulatory_notification_task');
        newReg.initialize();
        newReg.setValue('parent_cyber_incident', current.sys_id);
        newReg.setValue('notification_type', 'oaic_ndb_notification');
        newReg.setValue('state', '1');
		newReg.setValue('assignment_group', 'b7aa36d9c3d1431043481cedd40131f1')
        newReg.insert();
        current.work_notes = newReg.number + ': ' + newReg.getDisplayValue('notification_type') + ' created.';
        current.update();
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-08 03:59:06</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>d6696c0283a2c71044779cb6feaad3e6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>8</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Create REG when private information</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Cyber Incident Management" source="x_1776078_cyber_0">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Cyber Incident Management">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_d6696c0283a2c71044779cb6feaad3e6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-08 04:12:53</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=d6696c0283a2c71044779cb6feaad3e6"/></record_update>
